style.backgroundSystem: deep teal-green stage #17453B for hero and closing shots, warm off-white #F7F5F0 for infographic and trust shots, real soil and plant scenes for pain and comparison shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line leaf and cycle motifs only, single accent color, inside rounded info labels
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft grounded contact shadows for product shots; soft natural daylight around 5500K for soil and plant scenes; one gentle accent glow allowed behind the product
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent natural gardening ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep teal-green stage background #17453B, warm off-white #F7F5F0, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one vitality green accent #3E8E6B; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft grounded contact shadows, plus soft natural daylight for soil and plant scenes; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded info labels with thin-line leaf motifs; clean commercial product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright bag presentation and scale with natural even margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: the bag stays upright and stable in scale across the set; hero angle is a slight 3/4; product never covered by props
style.surfaceSystem: matte dark pedestals and kraft-paper #E9E0D2 tabletop for granule work; natural crumbly soil outdoors for scene shots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, no serif or handwritten fonts
